TWI friction-stir research describes solid-state joining with a rotating tool.; Draw tool axis, torque direction, travel path and workpiece support for paper-only calculation.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 恆扭矩旋轉功 W=τθ=τ2πN，轉數 N 無量綱。；機械功不全轉入接縫熱，且能量相同不代表流動、溫度或缺陷相同。
knowledge.textEn: At constant torque, W=τθ=τ2πN, where turn count N is dimensionless.; Not all work becomes seam heat, and equal energy does not imply equal flow, temperature or defects.
